name: Cera Sanitaryware Limited
summary: Cera Sanitaryware Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in building material products in India. The company offers sanitaryware comprising toilets, wash basins, cistern, seat covers, and fittings; faucets, showers, health faucets, and accessories; floor and wall tiles; shower partitions; kitchen sinks; and vanity cabinets and mirrors under the Senator, CERA Luxe, and CERA brands. It also exports its products. Cera Sanitaryware Limited was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
